description: This script is a command-line utility for managing and viewing logs related to the OpenClaw project on macOS. It interacts with the macOS unified logging system to display, filter, and export logs specific to the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem, with various options for filtering by category, severity, search terms, and output format.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays a stylized message guiding users to configure passwordless sudo access for the 'log' command when sudo fails due to password restrictions.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays the help message with instructions on how to use the 'clawlog' utility, including options, examples, and categories.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and displays recently active categories within the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem logs from the last hour.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user input to be safely embedded within macOS log predicate filter strings.
